newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bandits block highway, rob armored car.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bandits block highway, rob armored car.

text.p: About 15 armed men blocked a major Sao Paulo highway on Friday, fired several rounds into an armoured car, boarded it and made off with sacks of cash, police said.

Three guards in the private security company's armoured car were injured in the attack, which lasted just a few minutes and disrupted traffic on the Marginal Pinheiros, a main highway on the city outskirts.
Police said the gang blocked traffic by driving a beverage truck in front of the armoured car, which smashed into the wall of a slum bordering the highway.
The thieves made off with several sacks containing an unknown amount of money.
